name: Kraków
tagline: A royal old town with a heavy history
summary: The old town and castle fill one day, Kazimierz and Schindler's Factory another. Auschwitz-Birkenau and the Wieliczka salt mine each need a half or full day.
seasonNote: Winters are cold with poor air quality; December has a large Christmas market.
arrival: Trains run from the airport to the main station in about 20 minutes.
gettingAround: The old town is walkable; trams reach Kazimierz and Podgórze.
cashTip: Cards and phones are accepted nearly everywhere; avoid exchange booths with big spreads.
foodTip: Try pierogi, żurek soup, an obwarzanek bread ring and a zapiekanka in Kazimierz.
buyTip: Amber from certified shops, Bolesławiec pottery and linen.

connections.note: Air time only; buses and trains take 6 to 8 hours.

items.expect: 800 steps on a guided route of about 3 km; cool underground.
items.tip: Take the train from the main station and bring a layer.
